title: A Light Weight Multi-Distance fNIRS Dataset for Ball-Squeezing Task and Purposeful Motion Artifact Creation Task
description: A multi-distance, high-density fNIRS dataset recorded over the motor cortex with a lightweight system that includes an accelerometer. Participants completed a resting-state recording, a bilateral ball-squeezing task, and a motion creation task with instructed head and facial movements to deliberately induce motion artifacts. The dataset supports work on short-separation regression, motion artifact correction, and diffuse optical tomography image reconstruction.
methods_description: High-density multi-distance fNIRS was recorded over the motor cortex with auxiliary accelerometer data. The protocol had a 5-minute resting-state session, a ball-squeezing task for both hands (3 runs, jittered ISI of 5-15 s), and a motion creation task with six instructed movements (head tilts in four directions, eyebrow raising, saying 'hello'; ISI 5-10 s).
